subject: biology-2
question: During **gastrulation**, three **germ layers** form. Which germ layer gives rise to most of the muscle tissue of the body?

options.text: The mesoderm, which also forms bone and blood.
The ectoderm, which also forms the nervous system.
The endoderm, which also forms the gut lining.
All three layers contribute equally to muscle.

explanation: Muscle, bone, blood, and connective tissue are all mesodermal derivatives, so the mesoderm is the layer that gives rise to most of the body's muscle. B and C name layers whose derivatives are the skin and nervous system or the gut lining. D is false, since muscle forms from the mesoderm alone.
